title: Automation Integrity and Startup Renderer Refinement
premise: The primary genius cache is empty, so this audit expands through the live innovation pack and code inspection. Repo-owned work exists in public-safe automation helpers and the startup brief renderer; real launch proof gates remain external and must not be faked.

items.why: Session 109 added public-safe closeout helper scripts that correctly set windowsHide, but three of them import child_process directly. PromoGrind already owns a hardened safe-spawn wrapper; using it everywhere keeps the window-storm/Defender guard enforceable instead of relying on each helper to remember options.
items.evidence: docs/INNOVATION_PACK.json reports 3 direct child_process imports: scripts/closeout-step-3-7-parallel.mjs, scripts/record-skill-cost.mjs, and scripts/session-floor.mjs. Live reads confirm all three import spawnSync from node:child_process.
items.recipe: Switch those helper scripts to import spawnSync from scripts/lib/safe-spawn.mjs, then run node scripts/check-windows-hide.mjs and the closeout helper smoke commands.

L1.recipe: Replace direct imports in the three helper files and run node scripts/check-windows-hide.mjs.

L2.recipe: Replace imports, run node scripts/check-windows-hide.mjs, node scripts/record-skill-cost.mjs --skill audit --phase smoke, node scripts/session-floor.mjs --json, and node scripts/closeout-step-3-7-parallel.mjs.

L3.recipe: Complete L2 and add/extend a regression assertion so future public-safe helper scripts cannot reintroduce raw child_process imports.

items.why: The startup brief renderer is still a 1354-line god file even after the SCORE extraction. The context-meter block is a good next slice because it is pure, testable, and observability-sensitive; moving it out reduces renderer risk without changing product behavior.
items.evidence: docs/INNOVATION_PACK.json lists scripts/render-startup-brief.mjs at 1354 lines against a 900-line threshold. Live inspection shows loadLiveContextMeter and its fallback logic are local to the renderer and can be extracted behind a stable function.
items.recipe: Create scripts/lib/startup-context-meter-block.mjs for live meter loading/fallback shaping, update render-startup-brief.mjs to import it, and verify brief format plus golden/regression tests.

L1.recipe: Extract loadLiveContextMeter into a helper and preserve current renderer output.

L2.recipe: Extract the helper, add focused tests for live JSON and fallback behavior, and run node scripts/test-brief-golden.mjs plus node scripts/validate-brief-format.mjs docs/STARTUP_BRIEF.md.

L3.recipe: Complete L2 and extract the context-meter visual rows into the same helper with snapshot-like coverage.

items.why: Six launch-proof gates still require real-world evidence: mailbox delivery, Stripe purchase flow, friend beta, Brevo forwarding, Studio Ops Supabase capability, and production capture-key wiring. A good session keeps them visible while refusing fabricated evidence.
items.evidence: context/PROJECT_STATUS.json blockers enumerate the six gates, and blocker-preflight reports 0 locally actionable Human Action Required items.
items.recipe: Leave the gates as explicit launch blockers; do not mark them done until the corresponding real runner or provider evidence records proof.

L1.recipe: Record the honest deferral in the execution log and closeout brief.

L2.recipe: Also ensure TASK_BOARD and PROJECT_STATUS keep the proof gates explicit and non-fabricated.

L3.recipe: Add automation only if a real credential/proof path becomes available through the secrets gateway.

honestDeferrals: No production auth email proof without a real mailbox flow.
No Stripe proof without a real purchase/portal/subscription smoke.
No friend-beta proof without a real tester pass.
No Brevo or Studio Ops Supabase capability proof without the corresponding Studio Ops/provider action.
No capture readiness claim until the browser-safe Supabase anon key is actually wired into production config.

executionLog.evidence: Closeout helper scripts import spawnSync from scripts/lib/safe-spawn.mjs; windows-hide guard and helper smokes passed.
Added scripts/lib/startup-context-meter-block.mjs, rewired render-startup-brief.mjs, added focused regression coverage, and verified render/brief/local launch gates.
External launch proof gates still require real mailbox/payment/tester/provider/deploy-config evidence; no proof fabricated.
